scientific_integrity: An algebraic proof establishes the unbounded-length result. Finite exhaustive checks are supplementary. A known four-one ambiguous pair is acknowledged as prior literature, not newly discovered.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless multiplicity observations, binary alphabet, at most three ones or by complementation three zeros; reconstruction only up to reversal. No claims for all words of greater minority weight, higher-weight reduced observations, or robustness.
title: Two upper composition layers reconstruct binary words with at most three ones
